artworks.title: Banquet of Thyestes
artworks.description: Boccaccio's De casibus illumination (BL Royal 14 E V): the Thyestean banquet where Atreus serves Thyestes his own children — the infant Tantalus among the sons murdered for the plate that made the house of Pelops proverbial.

popCulture.title: Thyestes
popCulture.creator: Seneca the Younger
popCulture.description: Seneca's tragedy stages the feast itself — the murdered sons (Tantalus among them in the Hyginus line) as the revenge Atreus serves at table.
